description: Source code for pyspark.sql.context module, defining SQLContext, HiveContext, and related classes for Spark SQL integration.

classes.name: SQLContext
classes.description: Main class for working with structured data in Spark, providing methods to create DataFrames, execute SQL, manage tables, and configure Spark SQL settings.

classes.name: HiveContext
classes.description: Extension of SQLContext that integrates with Hive, supporting HiveQL commands and Hive metadata.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Deprecated method to get or create SQLContext; recommends using SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate() instead.

methods.name: _get_or_create
methods.description: Internal method to get or create SQLContext with optional static configuration.

methods.name: newSession
methods.description: Creates a new SQLContext session with separate SQLConf, views, and UDFs, sharing SparkContext.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Sets a Spark SQL configuration property.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Retrieves a Spark SQL configuration property value.

methods.name: udf
methods.description: Returns UDFRegistration for registering user-defined functions.

methods.name: udtf
methods.description: Returns UDTFRegistration for registering user-defined table functions.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame with a range of long integers.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Deprecated alias for spark.udf.register to register UDFs.

methods.name: registerJavaFunction
methods.description: Deprecated alias for spark.udf.registerJavaFunction to register Java UDFs.

methods.name: createDataFrame
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame from RDD, list, pandas DataFrame, or pyarrow Table with schema inference and validation options.

methods.name: registerDataFrameAsTable
methods.description: Registers a DataFrame as a temporary table/view.

methods.name: dropTempTable
methods.description: Drops a temporary table/view.

methods.name: createExternalTable
methods.description: Creates an external table based on data source and optional schema.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Executes SQL query and returns result as DataFrame.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Returns a DataFrame for a given table/view.

methods.name: tables
methods.description: Returns a DataFrame with list of tables in the database.

methods.name: tableNames
methods.description: Returns list of table names in the database.

methods.name: cacheTable
methods.description: Caches a table in memory.

methods.name: uncacheTable
methods.description: Removes a table from cache.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached tables.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns DataFrameReader for reading data.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Returns DataStreamReader for streaming data.

methods.name: streams
methods.description: Returns StreamingQueryManager for managing streaming queries.

methods.name: refreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes metadata cache for a table (HiveContext).
